author: rdc-rfc1-author-a (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: A three-stage chain on clk releases q's asynchronous clear.

author_reading.rationale: A three-stage chain on one clock releases the clear of q after three clock edges, with no clock crossing.

labels.rationale: rst_sync is a 3-stage synchroniser from rst_n on the same clock, and q is released by its last stage. Each stage has an identical async reset and no outside fanout.
Three stages shift in the released constant after asynchronous assertion. Only the final stage releases the receiving registers, on their own clock edge.
